model_annotation: The pie chart is divided into four sectors that compare the share of positive media coverage of political parties' projects across three different political groups. Each sector is labeled with the name of the political group, a color (or variation thereof), and a percentage value representing the share of positive media coverage. The largest sector represents the ruling party and occupies almost half of the pie, followed by the third largest and equally big share which makes up 23 percent of the pie. Majority of the block (also at 23 percent) represents other parties who also received a large share of positive media coverage. The smallest portion of the chart only takes up 3–percent of the pie. The sectors do not seem to be divided in any sort of interesting way (e.g lack of bubbles, “dim/bright” etc.).
